question: **Choose the incorrectly spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is: "**Structrure**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling of the word is "**Structure**".
 
• The incorrect spelling has an extra "**r**" in it.
 
• "**Structure**" refers to the arrangement or organization of something. (किसी चीज की व्यवस्था या संगठन)
 
 
• **Example**: *The structure of the essay was well-organized and easy to follow.*
 
 

Hence, **option 3** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**Recently**" is spelt correctly and means in the near past. (हाल ही में)
 
• "**Brush**" is spelt correctly and can refer to a tool for painting or cleaning. (सफ़ाई का ब्रश)
 
• "**Havoc**" is spelt correctly and means great destruction or chaos. (तबाही)
